ideas.title: The Impact of Federal Funding Cuts on Minnesota's Social Services
ideas.description: Investigate how federal funding cuts are affecting social services in Minnesota, including child care and welfare programs.
ideas.angle: The human impact of funding cuts on vulnerable populations
questions: How are funding cuts affecting service providers?
What are the consequences for recipients of these services?
ideas.insight: This story could highlight the consequences of federal actions on state-level social services and the populations they serve.

ideas.title: Patterns of Fraud in Minnesota's Welfare System
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of welfare fraud in Minnesota, including any patterns or connections to state officials or agencies.
ideas.angle: The extent of welfare fraud and potential connections to state government
questions: What is the scope of welfare fraud in Minnesota?
Are there any connections to state officials or agencies?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover systemic issues with Minnesota's welfare system and potential corruption at the state level.
